# outcome-metrics

Business-outcome observations for Micrometer with built-in guardrails; Spring Boot 4 + Quarkus 3.
0.1.0-beta.4 preview · Java 21+ · config prefix `outcome.metrics.*` (stable until 1.0)

## Artifacts

| Artifact | Purpose |
|---|---|
| `outcome-metrics` | Core: builder, schema, enforcement, vocabularies, `@MeasuredOutcome` |
| `outcome-metrics-spring-boot-starter` | Spring Boot 4 auto-config + AOP + scope filter + config enforcement |
| `outcome-metrics-quarkus` | Quarkus extension (preview) + CDI interceptor + config enforcement |
| `outcome-metrics-reactor` | Mono/Flux terminal binding (Spring aspect auto-detects) |
| `outcome-metrics-mutiny` | Uni/Multi terminal binding (Quarkus interceptor auto-detects) |
| `outcome-metrics-processor` | Compile-time `@MeasuredOutcome` validation (annotationProcessorPaths) |
| `outcome-metrics-test` | Test contracts, vocabulary attestation, SLO scaffolding |
| `outcome-metrics-bom` | BOM |

## The API: the recording builder

```java
observations.of("order.place").dims(KeyValues.of("channel", "web")).record(() -> place(cmd));

// compose classifications (first classifier's lambda parameter types the chain):
observations.of("payment.capture").dims(dims)
    .integrity((Payment r) -> r.complete() ? OutcomeIntegrity.OK : OutcomeIntegrity.DEGRADED)
    .idempotency(r -> r.wasNoOp() ? IdempotencyOutcome.DUPLICATE_SKIPPED : IdempotencyOutcome.APPLIED)
    .record(() -> handler.process(delivery));

@MeasuredOutcome(name = "order.reserve", tags = {"step=reserve"})  // annotation route
public Reservation reserve(String sku) { ... }
```

Builder methods: `dims(KeyValues)`; result-shaped (success path, fail loud on null/throw):
`integrity(IntegrityClassifier)` → `integrity=ok|degraded|empty`, `idempotency(...)` →
`idempotency=applied|duplicate_skipped`, `reconciliation(...)` → `disposition=confirmed|diverged|
abandoned|deferred` + auto `phase=reconcile`, `grounding(...)` → `grounding=aligned|
ignored_evidence|hallucinated_gap|no_corpus_needed`, `resultTags(tagger, "key"...)` (declared keys
preset `none` on failure; undeclared emitted key fails loud); execution-shaped (also fire on
failure, never throw/mask): `delivery(attempt, err -> DeliveryFate.RETRY|DEAD_LETTER|DROP)` →
`fate` + `attempt_bucket`, `resilient(() -> RetryShadow.of(attempts, dominantReason, shadowTime,
totalTime))` → `attempt_bucket`/`dominant_reason`/`shadow_cost` (`RetryShadow.firstTry()` for
clean calls). Terminals: `record(Runnable|Supplier)`, `recordChecked(...)`, `startDeferred()`
(plain builder only). Rejected at build time: `delivery`+`resilient`, duplicate declared keys,
classified `startDeferred`. Specialized `record*` methods are deprecated delegates (removal at 1.0);
plain `record`/`recordChecked`/`startDeferred(name, dims)` remain.

## Always-on tag schema

`outcome=success|failure` (always binary) · `reason=none|unknown|<code>` (never class names) ·
`integrity=ok|degraded|empty|none` · `alertability=page|ticket|none` (failure default: page) ·
`occurrence=first|repeat` (per `OutcomeScope`; no scope → first).
Never tag: user/order ids, emails, UUIDs, free text, idempotency keys, message ids/offsets/
partitions, intent/device ids, actor ids or hashes, fingerprints.

## Failure reasons & routing

Implement `OutcomeReasonSource.outcomeReason()` → `OutcomeReason` with `code()` (snake_case) and
`alertability()` (`PAGE` default | `TICKET` | `NONE`). Cause chain walked; unclassified →
`reason=unknown` + page. Route alerts on the `alertability` tag, never by regexing codes.

## Async terminals

`observations.of(name).dims(d).startDeferred()` → `DeferredOutcome.succeed()|fail(t)|cancel()`
(first terminal wins, any thread). `ReactorOutcomes.record(observations, name, dims, monoOrFlux)`
and `MutinyOutcomes.record(observations, name, dims, uniOrMulti)` bind per subscription (retry =
two attempts); `@MeasuredOutcome` auto-binds reactive returns when the adapter is present.
Cancel → `reason=cancelled` (schema floor), `alertability=none`. No scope in deferred mode;
infinite streams = never-stopped observations.

## Scope & virtual threads

`try (var s = OutcomeScope.open()) { ... }` dedups identical series per request
(`occurrence=repeat`); fails open across threads/caps; Spring filter: `outcome.metrics.scope
.enabled=true` (servlet only). Virtual threads: JEP 444 confines thread-locals per VT — no carrier
bleed (isolation-tested); pinning is execution cost, observe via `micrometer-java21`.

## Enforcement pipeline (order: privacy → registry → budget → guard)

```java
new OutcomeObservations(observationRegistry, OutcomeObservationConvention.builder()
    .tagPrivacyPolicy(TagPrivacyPolicy.saasDefaults())      // deny-keys + email/UUID/JWT/IPv4/hex/digit
                                                            // detectors → value `redacted`, never throws
    .reasonRegistry(ReasonRegistry.builder().vocabulary(MyReasons.class).codes("cache_stale").build())
                                                            // unregistered → unknown + forced page
    .reasonBudget(new ReasonBudget(8, 64))                  // over budget → other; expand() at runtime
    .combinationGuard(CombinationGuard.builder().keys("region","product")
        .minSupport(20).window(Duration.ofMinutes(15)).build())
                                                            // rare tuples → other; fails closed; NOT k-anonymity
    .build());
```

All are `MeterBinder`s; both frameworks compose them from `outcome.metrics.*` config. Tests:
`policy.violations(tags)` empty; registry `codes()` feeds attestation.

## Domain vocabularies (one-liners)

Shared resources: `SharedResource.owned|borrowed|pooled(type, tiers...).withPool(id).tags()` —
five fixed tags; UUID-shaped values rejected at construction.
SLO binding: `SloCatalog.of("checkout-success").binding(id)` → `slo` tag (undeclared throws at
wiring); info gauge `outcome.metrics.slo.info{slo}=1`; drift alert `absent(...)`; policy stays in
Sloth/OpenSLO; `SloScaffold` (test module) generates Sloth `prometheus/v1` skeletons.
Experiments: `ExperimentRegistry.builder().experiment("checkout-v2").build().slice(id, arm)`;
unregistered collapses (`unregistered`/`unknown`); unsliced traffic uses `.none()`.
Dual control: events tagged `DualControl.WitnessAction.*.tag()`; `recordGap(registry, name, dims,
storeDuration, GapClosure.COMPLETED|VETOED|EXPIRED)`; roles only, never id hashes.
Break-glass: stages `BreakGlass.Stage.ACTIVATION|ACCESS|REVIEW|CLOSURE.tag()` (alert on activation
rate); `recordReviewLag(..., ReviewVerdict.JUSTIFIED|UNJUSTIFIED|INCONCLUSIVE)`; metrics ≠ legal
audit trail.
Rail divergence: `RailDivergence.recordWindow(registry, name, dims, storeDuration,
DivergenceResolution.CONVERGED|RETURNED|ADJUSTED|WRITTEN_OFF)`; state pairs are caller dims.
Retention: `RetentionClass.AUDIT.tag()` (untagged = ops) + `RetentionFilters.auditOnly()` on a
`CompositeMeterRegistry` child; routing hint, never a legal guarantee.
Replay deltas: `ReplayDelta.classify(contextDiffers, verdictFlipped, latencyShifted, costShifted)`
— context drift voids the comparison; fingerprints never become tags.
Messaging buckets: `MessagingTags.attemptBucket(n)` (`1|2_3|4_plus`), `lagBucket(duration)`
(`lt_1s..gte_10m`); offsets/partitions never tagged.
Phases: `OutcomePhase.INTENT|COMMIT|RECONCILE.tag()` for offline sync flows.

## Cardinality & overflow

`tag-limits[]` remap excess values → `other` (meter survives); gauge
`outcome.metrics.tag_value_overflows`; `max-meters` registry ceiling. Label-set law: same tag keys
on every series of a name (legacy Prometheus clients crash on drift; the current client silently
splits aggregations — `hasConsistentLabelSets()` is the loud gate).

## Testing (outcome-metrics-test)

`assertThatOutcomes(registry).hasConsistentLabelSets().hasOutcomeSchema(name)
.hasSeriesCardinalityAtMost(name, n).hasNoPrivacyViolations(policy)`;
`ReasonVocabularyContracts.assertWellFormed(EnumClass)`; `VocabularyAttestation.builder()
.reasons(reg).slos(cat).experiments(exp).build().assertMatches(path)` (update:
`-Doutcome.metrics.attestation.update=true`); `OutcomePropagationContracts
.assertScopeConfinedAcrossExecutor(pool)`; optional `OutcomeArchRules`. Plugins: diagnose
duplicated library copies with `MetricTagValues.isForeignReasonSource(error)`.

## Overhead

~50 ns raw Micrometer timer; ~1.3 µs per outcome observation (Observation machinery); full
enforcement pipeline +~0.6 µs; open scope +~30 ns (indicative, see benchmarks/).
